services.name: Glow And Discover - Guided Night Kayak Eco Tour in Key West
services.desc: Discover the magic of Key West from a new perspective with our unforgettable Night Kayak Tour! What to Expect: Get ready for an exciting and serene kayaking adventure under the stars. Our Glow And Discover Night Kayak Tour will take you through the calm, crystal-clear waters of Key West, where you can explore the natural beauty of the area illuminated by the moonlight. You’ll glide past mangroves, through serene waterways, and possibly even spot nocturnal marine life shimmering in the water, creating a surreal and breathtaking experience. services.name: Key West Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Duration 2 hours About Sunset Cruise in Key West! We are headed to the sandbar and beyond, our skipper will take us out for a private boat tour into the backcountry waters. Watch as we anchor over the sandbar, reaching deep enough for you to jump from just above waist high water and get some awesome pics with the sun setting behind you – it’s really something special.
